menu_options.discover: Scan the local network for pumps

discover.title: Discovered devices
discover.description: Found {found} device(s) on the network.{already} If a device you expect is missing, it may have missed the discovery broadcast - go back and scan again, or add it manually by IP.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Jebao device at that address (checked with a directed LAN discovery packet).

abort.unsupported_product: This device's product_key ({product_key}) isn't in this integration's bundled schema list yet - see docs/SUPPORTED_MODELS.md.
abort.dhcp_mac_not_registered: This DHCP lease doesn't match any configured Jebao pump.

set_schedule_slot.name: Set schedule slot
set_schedule_slot.description: Programs one of a pump's 48 daily timer slots.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Wave mode index for this slot.

pulse_tide.name: Pulse tide
pulse_tide.description: Pulse/tide setting. Only used by pumps with 8-byte schedule slots; ignored otherwise. Optional.

feed_time.name: Feed duration
feed_time.description: Feed duration for this slot. Only used by pumps with 9-byte schedule slots (e.g. Wavemaker Pro); ignored otherwise. Optional.

cust_wave_freq.name: Custom wave frequency
cust_wave_freq.description: Custom-wave frequency for this slot. Only used by pumps with 9-byte schedule slots (e.g. Wavemaker Pro); ignored otherwise. Optional.

clear_schedule_slot.name: Clear schedule slot
clear_schedule_slot.description: Disables one of a pump's 48 daily timer slots.

sync_clock.name: Sync clock
sync_clock.description: Sets the pump's internal clock to Home Assistant's current local time. The 48 daily timer slots fire off this clock, so sync it after a power loss or if schedules fire at the wrong time.
